description: Repo-local Renovate config. The shared supply-chain posture lives in the
org preset (github>Studio81Labs/.github:renovate-base): schedule,
minimumReleaseAge (mirrored by pnpm-workspace.yaml — change both or
neither), vulnerabilityAlerts, docker.pinDigests, the pnpm dlx / npx CLI
pin manager, helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests, lockFileMaintenance, the
minor+patch grouping, the github-actions ci scope, and the Flutter- and
TypeScript-major blocks.
What stays here is tied to this repo's topology: the scope rules use this
repo's commitlint scope-enum, the react-native/react and ruby blocks exist
because the mobile app is bare React Native with CocoaPods tooling, and
the customManager matches a workflow file only this repo has.
Keeps the security scanners' container images current. They are
workflow `env:` values, not a package file, so no built-in manager
extracts them and the preset's pinDigests never sees them.
Registry-agnostic on purpose — an earlier ghcr.io-anchored pattern
silently excluded semgrep/semgrep (Docker Hub). References carry tag
AND digest; a bare name@sha256: gives no release line to track.
A prettier bump reformats the codebase and needs a `pnpm format`
commit beside it, which a grouped PR cannot carry (Renovate
force-pushes it away). Kept out of the weekly group so the reformat
lands deliberately.
Never bump the VALUE of a pnpm override. Renovate extracts each
override as a dep of type pnpm-workspace.overrides and offers to move
it — which rewrites a deliberate security/provenance pin out from
under its rationale (nexcue #823/#824/#825 were exactly that, one of
them a patch-level no-op that broke installs). Major-only blocking is
not enough, and check-pnpm-overrides.py deliberately allows a
documented cross-major pin, so neither half is sufficient alone.
minimumReleaseAge is inert while enabled:false but present because
semgrep's renovate-missing-minimum-release-age flags any
selector-bearing rule without it.

packageRules.description: Never auto-open react-native or react majors (too invasive)
Never auto-bump Ruby major — breaks CocoaPods / native tooling
Scope commits to poc-sensor when touching apps/poc-sensor
